symptom: Factory and QA completed with cargo test 34/34. The exact Factory-run projection was green, but the workspace aggregate split its successful workspace-validation evidence under project_id=factory_e0cda86d03da while the historical Bench attempt remained under project_id=L3-23.
root_cause: Same-stage QA retry rebuilt a context without project_id. Factory workspace-validation ledger persistence then fell back to run.id even though the immutable factory_start_request metadata retained the canonical project id. Run Ledger correctly kept distinct run attempts immutable, but the workspace aggregate consequently misattributed the successful Factory verifier epoch to a fake logical project named after the Factory run.
implemented_fix: Resolve the ledger project id from explicit retry context first, then the immutable Factory start-request project metadata, and only then run.id. Preserve append-only history and Run Ledger fail-closed evidence semantics.
required_tests: Workspace-validation persistence keeps the canonical project id when retry context omits project_id.
A fresh exact-run retry writes successful verifier evidence under the canonical project identity.
Historical failed Bench-attempt evidence remains queryable and is not deleted.
prohibited_actions: make failed command evidence globally non-blocking
restart PM, Chief Engineer, or Director
